prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Kansas City?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single objectively “best” agency — it depends on your goals, budget, industry and whether you need creative/branding, digital performance (SEO/PPC), social, PR, or full-service work.

Quick questions to narrow it down:
- What are your main goals? (brand launch, lead gen, e‑commerce sales, awareness, etc.)
- What’s your monthly/annual marketing budget range?
- Are you B2B or B2C? Any industry specifics?
- Do you want a large full‑service agency or a small specialist/boutique?

If you want a fast place to start
- Barkley — large independent creative agency headquartered in Kansas City, strong on branding and national creative campaigns.
- VMLY&R (VML’s KC roots) — global digital, customer‑experience and transformation work.
(Those two are among the most prominent KC agencies, but may be overkill if you need tactical SEO or local social media.)

How to choose the “best” for you
- Look for relevant industry experience and case studies.
- Check measurable results (ROI, conversion improvements) not just awards.
- Ask about team composition and who will do the day‑to‑day work.
- Request references and a short pilot project or trial period.
- Compare reporting cadence, communication style, and contract flexibility.

If you tell me your goals, budget and industry I’ll shortlist 4–6 Kansas City agencies (full‑service and specialists) that match your needs and what to ask them in an RFP.
